articleTitle: UAV Simulation Flight Training System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In Virtual Reality systems, we propose a flexible new technique to easily simulate Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) based on Unreal Engine and Visual Studio 2015. It only requires a personal computer, a head mounted display and a pair of handles. In this paper, some key technologies are emphasized, such as level building, physical and mechanics simulation of drones. Our system, combined with Virtual Reality technology, helps the trainees to immerse themselves into the virtual environment so that they could be trained more effectively and attentively without being affected by a wide range of environmental factors. Meanwhile, we implement a multi-task training model by adjusting parameter instead of undue hardware devices. The experimental result shows the feasibility of the UAV flight training system.

Author Keywords: unmanned aerial vehicle, physical simulation, virtual reality, training system

articleTitle: Aircraft Detection Based on Multiple Scale Faster-RCNN
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Remote sensing image recognition has been widely used in civil and military fields. In view of plenty of interference factors in remote-sensing aircraft, such as shade, noise, the changing of perspective, etc. An improved target recognition algorithm in remote sensing image based on Faster-RCNN is proposed which uses a standard Region Proposal Network (RPN) generation and incorporates feature maps from shallower convolution feature maps. Convolution neural network is adopted to recognize aircraft target in complex environment, enhance the global context and local information to avoid information loss in the process of feature extraction, which improves recognition rate. Simulation results show that the feasibility of aircraft target recognition algorithm in remoting sensing image and the scale and posture changes of target can be overcome. Meanwhile, the proposed algorithm has higher recognition effect and stronger robustness than traditional Faster-RCNN and BP neural network and support vector machine ( SVM) methods.

articleTitle: A Secure and Efficient Face-Recognition Scheme Based on Deep Neural Network and Homomorphic Encryption
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In recent years, with the maturity of face recognition technology, face recognition has been widely used in real life, raising concerns about the accuracy of face recognition results, the efficiency of face recognition and the safety of data. So we proposed a secure and efficient face-recognition scheme based on deep neural network and homomorphic encryption. The entire scheme is divided into two parts: the client and the server. The client obtains the face images. The server performs recognition. Face features are extracted using deep neural networks and then encrypted with the Paillier algorithm. The data of face features is transferred from the client to the server with encrypted mode and does not need to be decrypted in the entire recognition process. In the recognition process, we adopt a highly efficient secretive Hamming distance calculation method and introduce a parallel computing scheme to encrypt feature data and calculate the ciphertext Hamming distance, which greatly improves the recognition efficiency of the entire program. No messages are leaked between the client and the server on the entire scheme, which achieves the purpose of protecting privacy and security. Compared with the previous secure face recognition scheme, the experimental results show that we improve the accuracy of and the efficiency of recognition while ensuring security.

Author Keywords: ecognition, Homomorphic Encryption, Convolutional Neural Network, Efficient and Secretive Hamming DistanceParallel Computing

articleTitle: AR Teaching Experimental Based on Multi-Camera
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Aiming at the imbalance and insufficiency of high-quality teaching resources, and aiming at the lack of funds for students to do physical, chemical and geographic experiments in poverty-stricken mountainous primary and secondary schools, the team developed a virtual-real integration open-style experimental teaching environment based on multi-camera cooperation, multi-marking cooperation, multi-modal gesture and physical interaction relying on AR technology. Supporting more than five kinds of multi-modal interaction technologies, such as vision, hearing, gesture, touch, and physical objects, a human-computer interface based on Task-Oriented multi-interaction model is constructed, and an experimental development platform of Augmented-reality fusion is built.

Author Keywords: AR, human computer interaction, multi camera collaboration, multi-MARK collaboration, multi-marking cooperation, multi-modal gesture

articleTitle: A Large-Scale Scene Display System Based on WebGL
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In recent decades, computer vision has been a hot area of computer research while 3D reconstruction is one of the hot topics. With the improvement of 3D reconstruction theory and the rapid development of computer hardware technology, the reconstructed 3D models are enlarging in scale and increasing in complexity. Combining the aerial image of UAV with the 3D reconstruction of sequence images, it is of great value to carry out relevant research on the problem of 3D reconstruction of outdoor scenes. The fast rendering of these large-scale scene models is a challenge. At the same time, with the advancement of the HMTL5 specification, browsers have become more and more powerful, and WebGL has gradually gained support from more and more devices. The 3D rendering of the BS architecture will be the future direction of the rendering engine. The browser does not need to install the client program, which is convenient for users to access and process in any environment. Therefore, the large-scale scene display system based on web architecture is more convenient. In this paper, we designed a real-time display system for large-scale scenes, and studied WebGL based rendering frame techniques.

articleTitle: Design of Virtual Exhibition Hall of Chinese Traditional Costume Based on Unity3D
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Chinese clothing, as a cultural form, runs through the history of ancient China. Based on virtual reality technology and Unity3D development tools, this work designs and completes a traditional Chinese clothing display system based on virtual exhibition halls. Focusing on the use of Autodesk MAYA for virtual exhibition hall model production, traditional clothing model design and the use of Photoshop for virtual exhibition hall texture production in detail. The interactive development for the free browsing of the virtual exhibition from the first person is elaborated using Unity 3D. Some of the key points of technique during the whole development process are expounded. The work uses virtual reality technology to display China's representative traditional costume culture elements, allowing viewers to appreciate more intuitively and to understand Chinese traditional culture.

Author Keywords: traditional Chinese costumes, cultural connotation, aesthetic implication, virtual exhibition hall, clothing display, Unity3D, free browsing, virtual museum, clothing museum

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Shooting Range
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This paper takes the weapon test demand as the guide and uses virtual reality technology to build a virtual range construction. Combined with the actuality of the shooting range, this paper analyzes the simulation test rules and the necessity and feasibility of constructing a virtual shooting range. The author built a blueprint of the virtual shooting range, designed the equipment library of the shooting range and the guns in the shooting range to be freely selected.

Author Keywords: information technology, weapon system, virtual range, simulation training

articleTitle: Applicability Analysis on Three Interaction Paradigms in Immersive VR Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The work intends to research the characteristics and applicability of three different types of interaction paradigms in immersive VR environment. For this purpose, a three-dimensional VR scene is designed based on the Unity3D simulation engine, and three types of interaction paradigms, including graphical user interface interaction paradigm, gesture interaction paradigm and voice interaction paradigm, are developed into this VR scene respectively. And the designed immersive and interactive scenes are experienced with HTC Vive. Taking into consideration the development of three interaction paradigms, the computational costs of the running scene with different type of interaction paradigm, and the user learning cost, the characteristics of the three types of interaction paradigms areexploredandcomparedwitheachotherforapplicabilityanalysis. Furthermore, the recommendation for selecting the appropriate interaction paradigm in different circumstances is provided according to analysis result.

articleTitle: VR+BIM: Perception and Design Optimization of Highway
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Virtual reality provides a new means for sensing and displaying Building Information Modeling (BIM) from two-dimension to three-dimension. This work uses virtual reality technology to connect BIM models with human perception based on the modeling and integration of BIM models. A variety of virtual reality methods are provided to perceive the highway BIM, such as holographic imaging, panoramic publishing, 3D printing, virtual driving, virtual flight, virtual cycling, virtual walking, augmented reality construction model delivery, etc. Virtual reality realizes people-oriented evaluation and optimization for highway project design, and improves the scientific nature of highway planning and design.

Author Keywords: Design evaluation, virtual driving, building information modeling (BIM), virtual reality, highway project

articleTitle: Slice-Based Window Detection from Scene Point Clouds
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a comprehensive strategy to detect the windows from scene point clouds. First, the planar points are extracted after computing the dimensionality structure of each point. The planar points are then grouped into clusters based on the normal direction and distance between points. Next, the building walls are extracted from the scene point clouds according to a collection of characteristics such as surface area, normal direction, and topological relationship. Finally, the building facade is sliced both horizontally and vertically. A slice-based algorithm based on the point number is proposed to locate the windows. The experimental results demonstrate that our method can detect the window location quickly and effectively.

Author Keywords: Window localization, Slice-based algorithm, Point cloud, Point number, Local minimum/maximum point

articleTitle: VR+AR Industrial Collaboration Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Our work combining the immersion of Virtual Reality (VR) and the virtual-real fusion of Augmented Reality (AR), is a VR + AR industrial collaboration platform with realizing the combination of VR and AR. Our work contains a lightweight cross-platform voice communication system to enable operators to maintain real-time voice communication between VR devices and mobile devices. On the AR terminal of the diversified system, gesture recognition technology is integrated, therefore, users can achieve multi-person collaboration across platforms through natural and effective interaction. On the VR terminal of the system, both the industrial aided design function and the analog driving function with the destination of checking the effect of cooperative operation in time are contained, furthermore, the system integrates speech recognition function to make the interaction mode of our work more natural and effective. Besides, our work has a network synchronization user interface, which can provide immersive popular science introduction and operation guidance about industrial parts.

Author Keywords: Cross-platform Voice communication, Real time Network Syn chronization, Speech Recognition, Gesture Recognition

articleTitle: Virtual Campus Roaming Based on HTC VIVE
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Virtual campus roaming is the combination of scene roaming technology and virtual building scene, and it is an important branch of virtual reality technology. The virtual campus roaming system of Qingdao University has been established on the HTC VIVE platform. The interactive roaming between the experiencer and the virtual campus has been realized and the immersive effect has been achieved. The running results show that the HTC VIVE-based virtual campus roaming system of Qingdao University can better display the school profile and has a good human-computer interaction, which not only helps the outside world to understand the school environment, but also provides a basis for the digital campus.

Author Keywords: virtual reality, scene roaming, virtual campus, HTC VIVE.

articleTitle: Skeleton Capsule Net: An Efficient Network for Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Capsule network is a new type of deep learning method to improve the CNN module. Though it has performed quite well on classifying the MNIST dataset, there are few applications in other fields. Thus in this paper, we apply the capsule network on skeleton-based classification and propose a framework to explore the potential of it. Since the bottom layer of the capsule network is still based on convolution operation, we feed heatmap as well as raw skeleton data and reach good performance on convolution-based action recognition. Most researches take spatial and temporal features into consideration and they do help to recognition accuracy. We propose two different encapsulations to extract the spatial and temporal features of skeleton sequences. We perform our experiments on UT-Kinect and a portion of NTU RGB+D dataset, and we achieve best 87% accuracy on the NTU RGB+D dataset. We also find that the capsule network is suitable for the coarse-grained classification tasks. In a conclusion, not only the characteristics of capsule network are proved, but also an efficient method to recognize human action is realized.

articleTitle: Common Green Plants Identification System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: A plant identification system which is designed to integrate local edge algorithms with other classical recognition algorithms in a prototype system is mainly composed of the following two parts. One is the system interface and another is algorithm embedding. A convenient visual environment is provided for users by this system interface, and algorithm functions and other auxiliary functions are integrated. After selecting the system integration algorithms and setting the necessary parameters, the tested plant image is automatically recognized by this system and the corresponding plant images from the database with a brief description are displayed. The tested common green images can be accurately identified and good identification results are obtained by this system.

Author Keywords: plant identification, recognition algorithms, automatically, algorithm embedding

articleTitle: Research on Cylindrical Panoramic Video Stitching and AR Perspective Observation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In this paper, a cylindrical panoramic video stitching method based on template frame is proposed to realize 360°panoramic stitching, and based on AR device to realize perspective observation. Firstly, the template frame image is collected. Then the SURF feature points extraction and rough matching of template images are carried out, and then the feature points of mismatching are eliminated by the efficient feature point filtering method. Then, the exact matching feature points are projected on the cylinder, and the transformation matrix between two images is calculated in advance for subsequent video frame image fusion. Finally, image fusion is carried out after the cylinder projection of the subsequent video image. In addition, in order to improve the algorithm speed to meet the real-time requirements, CUDA platform is adopted for GPU parallel processing when implement the image cylinder projection and fusion. Experiments show that, real-time video stitching with 30 frames per second is realized.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Interactive VR Campus Roaming System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)

articleTitle: The Application of VR Life Science Museum
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: We implemented the VR Life Science Museum using the Unreal Engine 4. Based on virtual reality technology, combined with educational theory and design theory, the theme of life science is selected, and the VR experience system is designed and developed with the theme of the struggle between human body and cold virus.

Author Keywords: Unreal Engine 4, virtual reality technology, life science, VR experience system

articleTitle: Virtual Campus Roaming System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This project uses the self-developed oblique photography system based on full-frame ultra-high definition camera to realize fast 3D reconstruction and virtual reality roaming. The content of the work consists of three parts: Oblique Photography System; The block modeling and cluster computing strategy; Roaming and Interacting.

articleTitle: Mondrian Virtual Art Gallery
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This video displays a visitor roaming around the Mondrian Virtual Art Gallery from the first-person perspective, which was produced by Unreal4 Engine and other relevant virtual reality techniques, defined as a virtual art gallery, with the purpose of high simulation and visual reconstruction of classical works of Piet Cornelies Mondrian, a Dutch artist of De Stijl, who influences contemporary design of architecture, arts and other areas most. The visitor can roam around the Mondrian Virtual Art Gallery from the first-person perspective and enjoy Mondrian's different periods of classical works as well as several installation arts inspired and created form these works.

Author Keywords: virtual reality, high simulation, visual reconstruction, art gallery

articleTitle: VR Teaching of New Energy Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: VR teaching of new energy vehicles is a software application that combines virtual reality technology with new energy vehicle training operations. It is based on the immersive advantage of virtual reality and can provide forced simulation operations. Equipment key component simulation, large complex situation simulation, virtual experiment, operation training, etc. VR teaching of new energy vehicles can provide comprehensive technical support for the teaching of new energy vehicles, accelerate the application of virtual reality in vocational education, and reduce costs. The safety of learning has been significantly improved, the efficiency of learning has been improved, and the talent development of the new energy automobile industry has been promoted.

Author Keywords: VR, virtual reality, new energy vehicles, electric vehicles, vehicle simulation training, virtual simulation

articleTitle: The Virtual Reconstruction and Interaction System of Tomb of Tang Dynasty Prince YiDe
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: We achieve the virtual reconstruction of tomb of LiChongrun who is the Prince of Tang Dynasty and virtual restoration of the frescoes in the tomb by the technology of computer vision and virtual reality. Our goal is to solve the problem of Prince YiDe tomb's structure recovery and falling mural restoration, and improve the efficiency and effect of digital protection of cultural sites. We utilize high-precision photography, digital scanning and 3D model reconstruction to provide complete image information for the tombs. Combining sensory interaction, virtual roaming, image animation and other technologies to enhance the performance in virtual space, we let users have fully immersive experience and offer users a platform to learn the tombs of Tang Dynasty and enjoy the beauty of tomb mural. By this means, we can maximize the recording and dissemination of precious historical and cultural information contained in the cultural heritage itself.

Author Keywords: virtual reality, interaction experience, tomb of Tang Dynasty Prince YiDe, digital cultural heritage

articleTitle: The Extreme Sports of Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This project combines VR with maximal exercise, so that users can experience the pleasure of outdoor maximal exercise indoors through VR equipment, and feel the thrill of free shuttle in the vast scenes of snow mountains, cities, canyons, space, seabed and so on.

Author Keywords: Virtual Reality, Extreme Sports, Roaming, Outdoor

articleTitle: A Robust Method for Hands Gesture Recognition from Egocentric Depth Sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: We present a method for robust and accurate hand pose recognition from egocentric depth cameras. Our method combines CNN based hand pose estimation and joint locations based hand gesture recognition. In pose estimation stage, we use a hand geometry prior network to estimate the hand pose. In gesture recognition stage, we defined a hand language which based on a set of pre-define basic propositions, obtained by applying four predicate types to the fingers and palm states. The hand language is used to convert the estimated joint location to hand gesture. Our experimental results indicate that the method enables robust and accurate gesture recognition in self-occlusion environment.

articleTitle: SYVR Virtual Equipment Manufacturing Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: SYVR is a real-time simulation graphic engine focusing on equipment manufacturing. It is based on decades of research works of physics simulations, is able to provide services like real-time simulation for key parts of devices, large-scale com-plicated situation simulation, virtual experiment, operational training, visualization of concept design and etc., which con-sist of the whole process of virtual manufacturing and simulation. SYVR can provide comprehensive technology support for industrial 3-dimensional data, accelerate applications of VR to all aspects of industry, cut down development costs of equipment manufacturing significantly, highly increase effi-ciency of equipment design, and promote development of equipment manufacturing.

Author Keywords: Virtual reality, virtual manufacturing, virtual training, Mixed reality, Virtual environment

articleTitle: Distributed Refinement of Large-Scale 3D Mesh for Accurate Multi-View Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: As the scene of multi-view reconstruction becomes larger, a single machine can no longer satisfy the refinement of 3D mesh in large scenes including mesh simplification, subdivision, smoothness and recovering meaningful details. In this paper, We propose a distributed method to refine a large-scale 3D mesh for accurate multiview reconstruction. First, we divide the initial mesh into blocks directly, which can utilize computing power of each computer. And then we make simplification and subdivision on those blocks, which can reduce mesh's noise and remove redundant vertices, so as to generate a high quality mesh where the difference of the size of each edge is not too large. Next, we propose to split a graph consisting of multiple images in order to minimize the overlapped image data in each block. Finally, we use distributed variational surface refinement algorithm to capture meaningful details of mesh. The experiments on both public large scale data-sets and our very large scale aerial photo sets demonstrate that the proposed distributed method is fast and robust, and is suitable for all kinds of large scene areas.

articleTitle: AR Mechanical-Guiding Assembly System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Guiding assembly system based on AR is to apply the technol-ogy of Augmented Reality to guide mechanical assembly op-eration and teach or train freshmen. By the means of adapting AR glasses(HoloLens, Magic Leap One etc.), we use virtual information to guide operating real mechanic. AR operation can achieve better effect than traditional reality training, and make industrial assembly process easier for costumers to un-derstand. It can also decrease losses caused by operational error, therefore increases efficiency safety and productivity.

articleTitle: A Virtual Driving System Based on Customized Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: With the development of VR technology, simulation driving can provide diverse user experience. In this paper, we built an immersive simulation driving system by Unity 3D and VR technology and in this system Logitec G29 is served as an interactive device. In this system, the user can control the virtual vehicles in the traffic scenario through the behaviors of driver, including rotating steering wheel, braking, turning on the direction indicators and accelerating. The user-defined evaluation model can be introduced into the system easily to calculate the evaluation results through the user's operation data collected in real time, including braking time, steering wheel angle, etc. This feature makes our system can be used for drivingrelated training and assessment scenarios widely. We proposed a safety awareness assessment models and conducted related experiments to verify this feature. In addition, the system's scene can be changed according to different purposes, which make the system be more flexible to adapt to different types of virtual driving research.

articleTitle: Human Factors Virtual System in Naval Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The complexity of the man-machine-environment system of shipbuilding directly affects the user's physical and mental health, work efficiency, emotional changes, and etc. With the development of virtual reality technology, the visual virtual reality solution for ship construction and production is continuously optimized, and finally to the maximum extent to meet the needs of users.

Author Keywords: human environmental system, virtual simulation, KAT, Unity3D

articleTitle: VReading Multi-Sensory Reading Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The form of books is constantly developing with the upgrading of carrying media, and the emergence of electronic books has greatly shaken the traditional paper books. In recent years, with the combination of artificial intelligence, virtual reality, high-speed network and digital reading, the concept of "VR" has been applied to more and more industries. The introduction of VReading multi-sensory reading platform will bring new ideas to digital reading industry.

Author Keywords: Books, virtual reality, Space technology, Virtual environment, VR Book, Virtual interaction

articleTitle: A Roaming Game in 3D Reconstructed Campus
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This work is based on the campus of Tianjin University of Technology. It uses 3D reconstruction technology to build its 3D virtual scene. Then, use the Unreal Engine Unreal Engine to use blueprints, mixed spaces, animation montages, etc. to realize the three roaming modes of characters, vehicles and helicopters. Allowing visitors to experience the roaming campus realized by virtual reality technology. Promote campus culture in a unique way and increase campus awareness.

Author Keywords: campus roaming, unreal engine, three dimensional reconstruction

articleTitle: Anole: A Mix Reality Based Computing Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: We introduce Anole, a practice and research platform for teaching and research of Virtual Reality and Artificial Intelligence-related specialties.

articleTitle: Future Home Experience Pavilion
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Future home experience pavilion is a virtual reality mobile APP integrating design, publishing, sharing, browsing, trading and other functions. It is a perfect combination of virtual reality technology and mobile application development technology.

Author Keywords: virtual reality, mobile application, internet, e-commerce, home decoration, transaction

articleTitle: NLQA Based Knowledge Search for Virtual Geographic Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Big data has injected new vitality into the virtual geographic environment (VGE). The intelligent virtual geographic environment system has put forward higher requirements for the interactivity and intelligent services. Firstly, in this paper, we have constructed a multi-level semantic conversion model, and enhanced the Chinese geographic knowledge graph by structured geographic information data such as the vector data of map. And then, based on Chinese geographic knowledge graph, we have proposed a bilateral LSTM-CRF model to achieve natural language question answering for VGE. Combing geographic knowledge base with virtual geographic scenes, we experimented the method. The experimental results prove that the method which is natural language question answering (NLQA) combined with the knowledge base can shorten the distance between people and virtual scenes and enhance the immersion and interactivity of VGE. It is an important way for virtual geographic environment to become intelligent.

articleTitle: Effects of Mood on Memory: A Virtual Teaching Experiment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This is a virtual teaching experiment aimed to teach students to learn the interaction between emotion and cognition. With VR-based environments, the teaching experiment overcomes the traditional difficulty of mood induction in psychological laboratory. In addition, it allows students to make an individual experimental design based on the original one-way design, which helps to improve students' ability to design experiment. These two advantages of VR-based psychological experiment make it possible to provide students a teaching experiment on emotion in a psychology course.

Author Keywords: mood induction, emotional memory, teaching experiment, Virtual reality

articleTitle: K-12 VR Applications Based on ViveFocus Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In the traditional teaching mode, students generally learn knowledge through words and pictures. This method sometimes increases the difficulty of learning and reduces the efficiency of learning because it is not intuitive. We explore a new teaching model that applies virtual reality technology to K-12 education to change the traditional teaching method. In this article, we use the two knowledge points of science and Chinese(the shape of the earth, and poem Snow) to display in the form of virtual reality, providing students with an immersive and rich sensory experience, deepening Students' memory and understanding of knowledge points.

articleTitle: Dynamic Rendering of Sea Ice Breaking Based on Voronoi Algorithm in Ice Navigation Scene
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: According to the latest international convention, virtual reality scene rendering in ice navigation is absolutely necessary in the visual system of navigation simulator. And the sea ice model is the key part of the whole system, which could be real-time broken depending on the actual interaction requirements. For meeting requirements of realistic and real-time performance of ice navigation visual system, after analyzing the disadvantages of original algorithm, a new sea ice geometry-based modeling algorithm is offered in this paper. In this 3D sea ice geometry-based modeling, Voronoi diagram modeling algorithm are adopted, which could simulate icebreaking process and channel frozen up visually with high immersive and real-time simulated effects.

articleTitle: Flexible Ornament Selection System for VR Decoration Exhibition
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This paper presents a flexible ornament selection system for VR decoration exhibition. People can flexibly modify wallpaper and floor by using the Helmet-mounted virtual roaming in real-time interaction. The house scenario is modeling by 3ds Max and Substance source, the interaction design is simulated by Unreal Engine4 or Unity 3D. People can get a real immersion experience by using our system for ornament selection.

Author Keywords: virtual reality, ornament, Helmet mounted, real time interaction

articleTitle: The VR Model House Display of Real Estate
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The model house is a package of commercial houses, and is also a reference example of the decoration effect of the buyers. The model house is the face of a real estate, and its quality directly affects the sales of the house. While VR allows users to see things in a three-dimensional space in a timely and unrestricted manner, as if they were there. Therefore, combining VR with a model room can bring a better experience to users.

articleTitle: WEB3D-Based APP Generator for VR Exhibition
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: We design a WEB3D-based application generator for VR exhibition, which provides management and edit functions for VR scenes and models. Because our work is based on WEB3D and B/S architecture, user can make VR application instantly and easily. We develop the web editor by UE4, so it can get an excellent rendering performance and preview and modify model in real time. In this development process, we solve many problems caused by packaging UE4 to HTML5, such as loading local files, web page jumping problems. In order to help users creating VR scenes quickly, we provide some common templates. Therefore, this work is considered as an efficient tool for nontechnical users to create applications of VR exhibition.

Author Keywords: Application generator, VR exhibition, WEB3D, Unreal Engine 4

articleTitle: Physically-Based Algorithm for Natural Rime Growth Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In order to show a common natural landscape in winter, the charm of rime, an algorithm for rime growth simulation based on a physical approach is proposed in this paper. This algorithm mainly simulates two main kinds of rimes' growth, especially their morphology and direction, under the condition of surrounding factors, including the air pressure, temperature and wind. Firstly, this algorithm calculates the length of rime by using the icing conductor model which is established according to fluid mechanics and thermodynamic principles, a fractal method is introduced into our algorithm to simulate the morphology of the crystalline rime, and a segmentation method is for the simulation of the needle-like rime's morphology; After that, wind field is simulated by adopting the function of Perlin Noise. Finally, it analyzes the offset details of the rime growth in the wind according to its material mechanics knowledge. The wind force is used to calculate the deviation of rime. Experimental results show us that our algorithm in this paper can simulate two kinds of rime realistically, effectively and efficiently.

articleTitle: VR Shooting Training System Interaction Design
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: This topic aims to explore the virtual reality interaction design through the development of virtual reality shooting training system, and try to build a more realistic and easy to use virtual reality interaction design. By using virtual reality technology to solve the weakness of traditional shooting training, a virtual reality shooting training system that is safe, easy to use, has good environmental adaptability and does not require complicated maintenance is established. The main content of this topic includes the system requirements function design of the system, virtual reality scene design, virtual reality interactive interface design, virtual reality gripper interaction design, shooting performance prompt analysis and so on.

Author Keywords: virtual reality interaction design, shooting training system, visual programing, virtual reality training system

articleTitle: Spirited Away Interactive Scene Roaming
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Based on miyazaki hayao's classic Spirited Away as the creative inspiration, restore the classic story scene. This is a multi-subject cartoon, from which the audience can peer into the irony of greed and selfishness, from the importance of independent growth, and even the harmony between man and nature. The setting of each character image, after repeated deliberation and reflection, reflects various phenomena in the society. Therefore, in the process of creation, we hope to make these characters more deeply rooted in the hearts of the people, so that we can really understand the miyazaki hayao in the formulation of these people set, some of the inherent spirit.

Author Keywords: Spirited Away, Roaming, Interaction, Scene Restoration

articleTitle: Implementation of VR Scene of Sino-US Innovation Exchange Center
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: As a scenario experience project running on PC, this work takes roaming the Innovation and Entrepreneurship Education Center of the Department of Psychology of Beijing Normal University as the background, and takes the real scene inside the education center as the prototype, so that visitors can experience the roaming realized by virtual reality technology.

Author Keywords: scene experience, roaming, virtual reality technology

articleTitle: Gradient Domain Based Processing Method for Image Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Digital image synthesis technology is an important technology in the field of computer graphics. It is widely used in various scenes such as digital image editing, film and television production, graphic design and so on. Gradient domain is an important concept in digital images. It can reflect the degree of variation of pixel values in each location of a digital image in its adjacent areas, and has a good perception effect on the edges of objects in digital images. Gradient-domain image synthesis method is an effective technique in the field of digital image synthesis. Its goal is to select a specific region from the source image and fuse it into the background image so that the images which before and after the fusion have no fusion traces. Vivid and natural. In this paper, the characteristics of digital image synthesis method based on gradient domain are analyzed. The Poisson clonal algorithm is used for image fusion. The characteristics of the core equations involved in Poisson clonal algorithm are studied. The equations are solved by combining the characteristics of coefficient matrix. The process is optimized and the solution of the linear equation is replaced by a Gaussian elimination method with a conjugate gradient method, which enables the digital image fusion process to be completed within a user-acceptable speed range.

articleTitle: Parallel Crowd Simulation Based on Power Law
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Crowd simulation technology is increasingly used in the fields of film, animation, games, military training, and public safety. In this paper, we propose a parallel crowd simulation model based on Power Law. This model use CUDA architecture to parallelize the Power Law model on GPU, so that each agent's behavior simulation is synchronized on different threads. This model considers the fine effects of the microscopic model while significantly improving the model simulation efficiency, making it possible to simulate large-scale crowds in real time and can accurately obtain the status information of each agent in each frame.

articleTitle: Traffic Signs Detection and Augmented Reality Based on Multithreading
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: The detection algorithm of existing traffic signs was improved, and the implementation of traffic sign detection and recognition was described in detail. This article mainly contains the following: Through targeted feature extraction, a trained cascaded classifier is used to obtain the location of traffic signs. Combined with the previous detection results, feature extraction is performed on the specified part of the target. The results are analyzed according to the location of detection or the results of the trained support vector machine are used to classify, and the classification results are obtained to realize the recognition of traffic signs. The total number of samples used for goal training in this article has reached thousands. The test results show that the detection rate of the traffic sign under the trained scene has been more than 90%. The algorithm has been optimized by the multi-thread method and combined with augmented reality to achieve real-time feedback.

articleTitle: Virtual-Physical Interaction System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: We present a novel human-computer interaction (HCI) system called Virtual-Physical Interaction System (VPIS): On the one hand, offering a realistic product experience process in a Virtual Reality (VR) environment. On the other hand, the corresponding process is controlled by manipulating a tangibly product model in a physical world. Thus, the VPIS with a Virtual-Physical combination enhances user experience in HCI field, which can apply in several application scenarios (Aided Design). However, the implementation of this system is a challenging task that subsumes several fundamental problems as sub-tasks: target detection and tracking, gesture detection and recognition. In order to achieve the expected goal of VPIS, the system is based on the physical hardware (HoloLens, Leap Motion and 3D printer) and the existing computer vision (CV) algorithms.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Networks for Localization of Discriminative Regions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is the leading cause of avoidable vision impairment. Currently, manual DR detection is a time consuming task, which relies on well-trained clinicians with skills. In this paper, we propose a novel and automatic diabetic retinopathy (DR) detection method using deep convolutional neural networks (DCNNs). To identify the region of interests (ROIs), we design an attention mechanism for scoring the specific regions, referred as regions scoring map (RSM). The RSM is based on deep convolutional neural networks, which are trained only with image-level labels on a large scale DR dataset. Specifically, the RSM is mainly inserted into deep residual networks between intermediate stages. With RSM, the proposed model can score the different regions of an retina image to highlight the discriminative ROIs in terms of image severity level. In experiments, around 30000 colour retinal images are used to train the proposed model and around 5000 images are collected to evaluate its classification performance. The results show that our DCNN model can obtain comparable performance while achieving the merits of providing the RSM to locate the discriminative regions of the input image.

articleTitle: User Profile Analysis for Enhancing QoE of 360 Panoramic Video in Virtual Reality Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: With the development and popularity of virtual reality (VR) and 360 panoramic videos with head mounted display (HMD), user satisfaction is very significant as compared to other important end to end quality of service. To improve Quality of Experience (QoE) of 360 panoramic video, user profile needs to be analyzed. The user profile analysis can provide vital information to service providers which can help them to deal with their resources capably, by evaluating users behaviour and expectation. In this paper, we conduct a subjective test and propose a method to investigate QoE in VR by analyzing user profile. To do this, we first store the user profile data (e.g. age, gender, familiarity with 360 panoramic VR video, interest in the content) then we investigate the impact of different factors that influence QoE (encoding parameters, content type and device type) on user. The results of our analytical study provide another opportunity for content providers to offer best level service that meets customers expectations and desired experience to obtain high user satisfaction. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first attempt that analyzes the user profile for 360 panoramic videos in VR environment.

articleTitle: Virtual Reassembly of Fractured Bones for Orthopedic Surgery
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: In orthopedic surgery, the traditional restoration of comminuted fracture basically relies on surgeon's manual work, which is usually intricate and error-prone. If fractured bones are poorly reassembled, the patient may suffer from more exposure to radiation and longer recovery time. More severely, some operation mistakes can cause sequela, such as joint dysfunction and infection. Therefore, orthopedic surgeons urgently need an intelligent assistance solution to improve the accuracy and reliability of fractured bones reassembly in procedure. This paper presents an automatic pipeline for virtual reassembly of fractured bones which are broken into pieces. It uses an intact bone as a template. We first reconstruct the 3D fractured bone from CT data using MIMICS. Then we analyze the shape structure of bone model through extracting key feature points and comparing descriptors. Finally, we search the correspondence between the fragments and template. The aligning is performed to ensure the fragments can join together. Compared with some semi-automatic reassembly methods for archaeological artifacts and forensic evidences, ours is fully automatic without human interactions and specialized to medical purposes. It can help orthopedic surgeons to make correct decisions in fractured bones reassembly.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Hair Modeling from a Single Image
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Hair is one of the most distinctive part of a human body, which is essential for the digitization of compelling virtual avatars. We present a data-driven approach for generating complete and complex 3D hairstyles from a single-view portrait. We construct a hairstyle database which contains more than 2000 hair models. Given a target hairstyle portrait image, we first draw a few strokes as guidance. We then search multiple best matching examples from the database based on our enhanced matching algorithm. Finally, we combine them consistently into a single hairstyle. The generated hairstyles are visually comparable to original portrait images. The reconstructed 3D hair models can be used for many applications, such as hair editing, and dynamic hair simulation.

articleTitle: Keyframe-Based Texture Mapping for RGBD Human Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: Realistic human model has a wide range of requirements in 3D content creation. A model with high-quality texture map can display human body surface details in low facets which could be toughly represented by geometric mesh. Image-based texture mapping suffers from discontinuities due to geometry inaccuracy, camera pose drifts, and illumination changes. In this paper, we propose a keyframe-based texture map generation method to obtain more desired texture mapping results. Our method firstly acquire the keyframes by performing a spatio-temporal sampling strategy, rather than just sampling keyframes according to time interval. Then, we apply an efficient patch-based optimization to the keyframes to make the texture data in different views alinged with each other. Finally, we generate a texture atlas from the aligned texture and the simplified mesh. Experimental results demonstrate that our method can get realistic human models with low facets and competitive details within short minutes.

articleTitle: Preliminary Exploration of Three-Dimensional Visual Variables in Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization (ICVRV)
abstract: As a theoretical basis for the design of plane graphic symbols, visual variables play a very important role in the symbolization of plane maps. However, the visual variables in plane map symbols are not fully applicable to three-dimensional models. This paper combines the features of virtual reality technology and integrates the aGlass VR eye tracking module with HTC Vive virtual reality devices, selects the basic visual variables (colour, size and spatial pose) in the three-dimensional scene for research. We organized and extracted the research process, and in this way, constructed set of incompletely mature research frameworks for visual variables.
